data.long_meaning: Naadirah is a beautiful and precious name in Arabic, derived from the word 'na'dara' which means 'to give'. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies the idea that every child is a gift from Allah, and a precious blessing. The name Naadirah carries the meaning “A Precious Gift” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naadirah usually hope their child will grow to embody a precious gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
